biblio.label: U.S. Patent Application Publication No. US 2024/0087784 A1
biblio.title: Magnetic coupling device
biblio.abstract: Magnetic coupling devices are disclosed. The magnetic coupling devices may include sensors, retractable pins, stationary pins, probes, and/or additional tools. The magnetic coupling devices may include multiple sets of pole portions, a first set may be received in an opening in a first magnet of the magnetic coupling device and a second set may be outside of an envelope of the first magnet.

summary: This document discloses a magnetic coupling device, which may include sensors, retractable pins, stationary pins, probes, and/or additional tools, for magnetically coupling to a ferromagnetic workpiece.

rows.label: claim 1[a]
rows.claim_text: A magnetic gripper for gripping a ferromagnetic workpiece, said magnetic gripper comprising
rows.claim_paraphrase: A magnetic gripper for gripping a ferromagnetic workpiece, said magnetic gripper comprising
rows.quote: A magnetic coupling device for magnetically coupling to a ferromagnetic workpiece, comprising: a housing;
rows.note: This passage discloses a magnetic coupling device for magnetically coupling to a ferromagnetic workpiece, which is a type of magnetic gripper, and includes a housing.
rows.disclosure: The reference discloses a magnetic coupling device for magnetically coupling to a ferromagnetic workpiece, comprising a housing.

rows.label: claim 1[b]
rows.claim_text: a magnet which is arranged in the housing and which is displaceable along a displacement direction between a gripping position for gripping the ferromagnetic workpiece and a release position for releasing the ferromagnetic workpiece
rows.claim_paraphrase: a magnet which is arranged in the housing and which is displaceable along a displacement direction between a gripping position for gripping the ferromagnetic workpiece and a …
rows.quote: a switchable magnetic flux source supported by the housing including a plurality of permanent magnets, the plurality of permanent magnets including a first permanent magnet and a second permanent magnet movable relative to the first permanent magnet
rows.note: This passage discloses a magnet (switchable magnetic flux source) arranged in a housing and movable relative to another magnet.
rows.disclosure: The reference discloses a switchable magnetic flux source supported by the housing, including a plurality of permanent magnets, where a first permanent magnet and a second permanent magnet are movable relative to each other.

rows.label: claim 1[c]
rows.claim_text: a number of pole shoes attached to the housing, wherein each pole shoe has a workpiece contact surface and is designed to guide a magnetic field portion of the magnet to the workpiece contact surface
rows.claim_paraphrase: a number of pole shoes attached to the housing, wherein each pole shoe has a workpiece contact surface and is designed to guide a magnetic field portion of the magnet to the …
rows.quote: a plurality of workpiece engagement surfaces supported by the housing and magnetically coupled to the switchable magnetic flux source, the plurality of workpiece engagement surfaces adapted to contact the ferromagnetic workpiece
rows.note: This passage discloses a plurality of workpiece engagement surfaces supported by the housing, which are analogous to pole shoes, and are designed to contact the workpiece and guide the magnetic field.
rows.disclosure: The reference discloses a plurality of workpiece engagement surfaces supported by the housing and magnetically coupled to the switchable magnetic flux source, which are adapted to contact the ferromagnetic workpiece.

rows.label: claim 6[c]

rows.note: This passage describes a channel located between pole portions, which is analogous to a recess between projections.
rows.disclosure: The reference discloses a channel located between the first north pole portion and the first south pole portion.
